name: Otsuka Holdings
h1: Integrating growth while reprioritising the work
lede: Otsuka is integrating Transcend Therapeutics and maintaining NEXT8 investment through a lower-profit FY2026. Airtable helps teams reprioritise and track cross-functional programmes in one place.
why_h2: Investment held steady through a transition year
why_p: Record FY2025 results, a guided dip in FY2026 and a major acquisition all landed in the first half of 2026.

signals.title: Transcend Therapeutics acquisition
signals.body: Otsuka Pharmaceutical agreed to acquire Transcend Therapeutics for US$700 million upfront plus up to US$525 million in milestones, expanding psychiatry and neurology.
signals.angle: Integration is cross-functional. A shared integration tracker keeps workstreams, owners and dependencies visible.

signals.title: Record FY2025, lower FY2026 guidance
signals.body: Otsuka reported record revenue of JPY 2.47 trillion and guided FY2026 business profit down about 20 per cent on loss of exclusivity, while maintaining NEXT8 investment.
signals.angle: When budgets tighten but investment continues, teams that can reprioritise work in one place move faster.

signals.title: Share buyback under way
signals.body: Under the buyback announced in February, Otsuka had repurchased 2,798,100 shares worth JPY 29.9 billion by 30 June 2026.
signals.angle: Capital discipline puts a premium on efficient operations and clear visibility of programme spend.
